### Isaac and Esau
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/isaac-and-esau
Passage: Genesis 27:30-38
Points:
- Isaac trembled violently when he realized God had sovereignly intervened to overrule his attempt to bless Esau.
- Acknowledging the Lord's authority, Isaac demonstrated repentance by affirming that Jacob's blessing was final.
- Esau bitterly accused Jacob of deceit while ignoring his own earlier choice to despise and sell his birthright.
- Rather than grieving over his sin against God, Esau wept only over his lost status and temporal privileges.
- Genuine confession requires acknowledging our offense against the Lord rather than merely lamenting lost worldly benefits.
